events.name: Megan Woods: The Truth Tour - Spokane, WA
events.info: Following a breakout year and a successful spring run, "The Truth" singer Megan Woods is bringing The Truth Tour back this fall for an extended 30-city run across the U.S. Building on the momentum of her first-ever headlining tour, Megan will continue sharing the songs and stories that have resonated with fans nationwide. Returning as a special guest is Jeremy Rosado, known for his appearances on American Idol and The Voice, bringing his signature warmth and authenticity to each night. Together, they'll create evenings filled with meaningful worship, genuine connection, and a powerful reminder of God's truth.
